correspondences.notes: BIDS accepts .nwb only as an iEEG format; general NWB content has no BIDS counterpart.

brainlife.desc: Neurodata Without Borders (NWB, HDF5) file; on brainlife.io used for pose-estimation data from animal behaviour sessions.
brainlife.name: neuro/nwb
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Input to VAME behavioural motif learning from pose estimates.

**Not for:** Assuming any particular content: NWB can hold ephys, imaging or behaviour; check the file.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.nwb.json

files.desc: NWB 2.x HDF5 file with session data and metadata.

identifying_risks: NWB subject and session metadata (IDs, session start time) and linked video.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 1 depends on species; human NWB is participant-level (step 6) unless identifiers remain (step 5).
sharing_cautions: Check subject and session_start_time fields before sharing human data.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 for animal-only data; tier 3 if human data with identifiers, dates or video.
